name: ModelVariant681_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant681_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (one or two flickering flashes that slide toward the model, rings of Gouraud strips and spinning burst sprites released from model points, a spinning dome of sprites wrapped in a cone of strips, and rows of sparks that drift away); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-698 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant698_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
